ko.executive_summary: Datacenter growth is positioning Teradyne (TER) as a competitive threat to Cisco (CSCO) and Viavi (VRT) in optical communications. Credo is advancing AI data center connectivity solutions, reflecting industry focus on scaling interconnect for AI workloads.
key_facts: Teradyne (TER) competing against Cisco (CSCO) and Viavi (VRT)
Credo Technologies active in AI data center connectivity

implications.text: New entrants like Teradyne leveraging datacenter tailwinds to challenge established optical comms incumbents, signaling market share shifts.
Credo's focus on AI datacenter connectivity reflects urgent customer need for higher-speed, higher-density interconnect to support AI model training and inference.
